input: Order custom return address stamps for envelopes

gold.taskTitle: Order Custom Return Address Stamps for Envelopes
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to purchase custom return address stamps personalized with their address details for use on envelopes.

questions.title: What is the full return address to be stamped?
questions.description: Capture the exact name, street address, city, state, and ZIP code that should appear on the stamp.

questions.title: Do you prefer a self-inking, pre-inked, or traditional stamp?
questions.description: Identify the stamp mechanism type, as this affects cost, longevity, and ease of use.

questions.title: What ink color do you want for the stamp impression?
questions.description: Determine the preferred ink color, such as black, blue, red, or a custom color.

questions.title: Do you have a specific design style or font in mind?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a plain text layout, a decorative border, a monogram, or a specific font style.

questions.title: What quantity or volume of stamping do you expect to do?
questions.description: Gauge usage frequency to recommend the right stamp durability and ink capacity.

questions.title: Is there a budget limit per stamp or for the whole order?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter vendor and product options appropriately.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline by which the stamp must arrive?
questions.description: Determine if standard shipping is acceptable or if expedited production and delivery are needed.
